Tests translating a multi-path disjoint optimization into a global graph flow model; checks reconstruction of paths and understanding of vertex-disjoint constraints.

## Key Concepts
- Vertex-splitting to enforce disjointness
- Min-cost max-flow on a grid DAG
- Path reconstruction from residual network

## Code Example
```javascript
class MinCostMaxFlow { /* skeleton: addEdge, dijkstra, etc. */ }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How to handle larger k or grids? 
- Can you optimize memory for dense graphs?

- Backtracking for solution paths
